timestamp.behavior: Trend source records require a valid timestamp.

mitre_technique.behavior: MITRE technique may be NULL or empty in source events. Such events must not be assigned a fabricated trend value.

attack_type.behavior: Attack type may be NULL or empty in source events.

attack_stage.behavior: Attack stage may be NULL or empty in source events.

session_id.behavior: Missing session identity must remain missing and must not be fabricated.

deferred_rules: MITRE_TRENDS remains DEFERRED until the actual ML event output is available.
The exact join key between MITRE source relationships and event/session data is not assumed by this contract.
The exact derivation of trend_date is not assumed by this contract.
The exact derivation of event_count is not assumed by this contract.
Only source-supported MITRE dimensions and values may contribute to trend records.
Missing MITRE fields must not be converted into fabricated values.
independence_rules: MITRE_TRENDS must not modify source events.
MITRE_TRENDS must not generate ML features.
MITRE_TRENDS must not perform feature scaling.
MITRE_TRENDS must not alter production cluster assignments.
MITRE_TRENDS must not fabricate MITRE enrichment.
MITRE_TRENDS must operate independently of downstream dashboard consumers.

availability.reason: The current Real ELK dataset does not provide sufficient validated MITRE data to execute and close MITRE_TRENDS.
availability.activation_condition: Actual ML event output must be received and validated against the MITRE_TRENDS input contract.
